description: The current US hiring market for one healthcare, finance, IT, engineering, science, HR, legal or marketing occupation, nationally or in one state: live postings, employers hiring, the posted pay range and employment type. Read from employers' own careers sites and rebuilt daily. Occupation in plain words (e.g. "registered nurse", "accountant", "software engineer"); state as a code or name, or US. Free; no employer is named. How fast employers close the role, what each requires, and one posting against every employer hiring it by name are in the Competitive Hiring Report (request_competitive_hiring_report; first report free).

occupation.description: A healthcare, finance, IT, engineering, science, HR, legal or marketing occupation in plain words

state.description: Two-letter US state, a state name, or US (the default)

title: Hiring market for an occupation
